cited_share.metric: Combined share of Google's orders for 800G-plus optical modules (customer-specific, NOT global market share)
cited_share.value: nearly 80% of Google's orders for 800G-plus optical modules
cited_share.period: undated — the source says only "expects ... to capture", with no year attached
cited_share.source_name: TrendForce press release — "Google's High-Speed Interconnect Architecture to Push 800G+ Optical Transceiver Share Past 60% by 2026"
cited_share.caveat: A share of one customer's orders, not of the market. TrendForce attaches no year to it.

cited_share.metric: Combined revenue share of the top Optical Transport SYSTEMS vendors
cited_share.value: over 80 percent combined revenue share
cited_share.period: trailing four quarters ending 2026Q1 (i.e. 2Q25–1Q26 on Dell'Oro's stated convention)
cited_share.source_name: Dell'Oro Group press release — "Optical Transport Equipment Market Forecast to Grow 16 Percent in 2026"
cited_share.caveat: Optical transport systems in the four quarters to March 2026, not the whole transport market and not today: by mid-2026 Dell'Oro's top four had changed.

cited_share.metric: Lead vendors in IPoDWDM ZR/ZR+ pluggable optics
cited_share.value: the lead vendors were Marvell and Cisco Acacia
cited_share.source_name: Dell'Oro Group press release — "Optical Transport Equipment Market Forecast to Grow 16 Percent in 2026"
cited_share.caveat: A lead-vendor statement with no share attached to it.

cited_share.metric: Top four Optical Transport Systems vendors — latest trailing window
cited_share.value: the top four vendors were Huawei, Ciena, Nokia, and Cisco (Acacia); no combined share percentage given. Market grew 15% y-o-y in 2Q 2026
cited_share.period: trailing four quarters 3Q2025–2Q2026; growth figure is 2026Q2
cited_share.source_name: Dell'Oro Group press release — "Optical Transport Equipment Market Grew 15 Percent Year-over-Year in 2Q 2026"
cited_share.caveat: The current vendor line-up. Dell'Oro publishes no combined share for this window.

cited_share.metric: Omdia six-year forecast for the global optical-components market, as reproduced in Accelink's annual report
cited_share.value: total market to reach US$90.9bn by 2030, 13% CAGR
cited_share.source_name: 武汉光迅科技股份有限公司 2025年年度报告全文, 十一、公司未来发展的展望 (p.19)
cited_share.caveat: A forecast, and on the optical-components basket rather than transceivers.

cited_share.metric: Global optical-components market size and growth, per Omdia as reproduced in Accelink's annual report
cited_share.value: US$24.3bn rolling-four-quarter revenue, up more than 50% y-o-y; single-quarter record US$7.12bn
cited_share.period: rolling four quarters to 2025Q3 (i.e. 2024Q4–2025Q3, as defined elsewhere in the same filing)
cited_share.source_name: 武汉光迅科技股份有限公司 2025年年度报告全文, p.10
cited_share.caveat: Optical components, not transceivers: dividing a transceiver revenue by this market size would mix two different baskets.

cited_share.metric: Global optical-components (光器件) market share and rank, per Omdia as reproduced in Accelink's statutory annual report
cited_share.value: 5.9% share, rank 5 globally overall; datacom optical components rank 4 (5.9%); telecom rank 5 (5.6%); access rank 4 (7.6%)
cited_share.period: rolling four quarters 2024Q4–2025Q3 — NOT FY2025; relabelling it "2025" would be wrong
cited_share.source_name: 武汉光迅科技股份有限公司 2025年年度报告全文 (披露日期 2026-04-23), p.9–10
cited_share.caveat: Omdia's figure as reproduced in Accelink's own annual report, on the optical-components basket — wider than transceivers, where Accelink ranks fourth — and over the four quarters to September 2025.

cited_share.entity: industry — global Top 10 optical transceiver suppliers
cited_share.metric: Top 10 optical transceiver suppliers ranked by optical-transceiver sales ONLY (excludes all other product lines; DWDM-module system vendors Cisco/Ciena/Huawei/Marvell/Nokia excluded by design)
cited_share.value: 2025: 1 Innolight; 2 Eoptolink; 3 Coherent; 4 Accelink; 5 Molex; 6 Ligent (Hisense); 7 HG Genuine; 8 Source Photonics; 9 Lumentum; 10 CIG
cited_share.period: CY2025. Same figure restates CY2024 on the new methodology: 1 Innolight, 2 Coherent, 3 Eoptolink, 4 Accelink, 5 HG Genuine, 6 Ligent (Hisense), 7 Source Photonics, 8 Molex, 9 Lumentum, 10 CIG
cited_share.source_name: LightCounting, LightTrends Newsletter, May 2026 — "AI Boom Accelerates Transitions Across the Industry Supply Chain"
cited_share.caveat: Ranked on optical-transceiver sales alone. Cisco, Ciena, Huawei, Marvell and Nokia are excluded from the ranking by design, so this is not a league table of optical vendors in general.

cited_share.entity: industry (optical transceivers and related products, incl. AOCs)
cited_share.metric: Worldwide sales of optical transceivers and related products — LightCounting's "final count" for 2025
cited_share.value: US$26.8bn, up 74% from 2024
cited_share.source_name: LightCounting, LightTrends Newsletter, June 2026 — "Acacia is on fire and so is the broader transceiver market" (Q2 Quarterly Market Update)
cited_share.caveat: LightCounting's final count for 2025, revised up from the US$23.8bn it published in March 2026, and on a basket that includes active optical cables as well as transceivers.

cited_share.entity: Innolight (中际旭创 300308), Eoptolink (新易盛 300502), Coherent (COHR)
cited_share.metric: 2025 full-year datacom optical component revenue — vendor rank order, with the leader's absolute revenue
cited_share.value: Innolight led datacom revenue with more than US$5bn, followed by Eoptolink and Coherent
cited_share.period: CY2025 full year (actuals from the closed 4Q25/full-year report)
cited_share.source_name: Cignal AI press release — "Datacom Optical Component Revenue Surpasses $19B in 2025"
cited_share.caveat: Cignal's estimate of Innolight's datacom optical component revenue, not of its total revenue. Ranks two and three are implied by the wording; the release never numbers them and gives them no revenue.

cited_share.metric: Total datacom optical component revenue
cited_share.value: more than US$19bn in 2025
cited_share.source_name: Cignal AI press release — "Datacom Optical Component Revenue Surpasses $19B in 2025"
cited_share.caveat: Datacom optical components, a wider basket than transceiver modules — it is not the denominator for any transceiver figure on this page.

cited_share.entity: industry — Chinese-language rendering of LightCounting's 2025 Top 10
cited_share.metric: 2025 global optical module vendor Top 10 with Chinese entity names (the granular ranks LightCounting does not print in text)
cited_share.value: rank 1 中际旭创 (Innolight, 300308); rank 2 新易盛 (Eoptolink, 300502); rank 3 Coherent (INFERRED, not stated); rank 4 光迅科技 (Accelink, 002281); rank 6 纳真科技 (ex-海信宽带); rank 7 华工正源 (华工科技 000988); rank 8 索尔思光电 (东山精密 002384); rank 10 剑桥科技 (603083) — 7 of the Top 10 are Chinese
cited_share.source_name: C114通信网《光模块厂商全球Top10：中国包揽前2，7家入围》(作者 南山)
cited_share.caveat: C114 is relaying LightCounting's ranking, and is used here only because it names ranks six to ten, which LightCounting's own text does not. Rank three is an inference by both outlets, not a published position.

cited_share.entity: industry (optical transport equipment); Huawei, Ciena, Nokia, ZTE, Cisco
cited_share.metric: 2025 optical transport market size, growth and top-five vendors by revenue share
cited_share.value: market grew 10 percent to US$16bn in 2025; DCI WDM up nearly 40 percent; top five 2025 vendors by revenue share: Huawei, Ciena, Nokia, ZTE, Cisco
cited_share.source_name: Dell'Oro Group press release — "Optical Transport Market Grew to $16 Billion in 2025"
cited_share.caveat: Optical transport equipment again — systems, not modules.

cited_share.metric: Global AI-focused optical transceiver market size and growth
cited_share.value: US$16.5bn (2025e) → US$26bn (2026f), over 57% y-o-y growth
cited_share.period: CY2025 estimate → CY2026 forecast — BOTH are TrendForce projections; 2025 is not an audited actual
cited_share.source_name: TrendForce press release — "Global AI Optical Transceiver Market to Reach US$26 Billion in 2026; Component Shortages Identified as Primary Capacity Expansion Bottleneck"
cited_share.caveat: Both years are TrendForce projections, and the scope is AI-focused transceivers only.

cited_share.metric: LightCounting's own estimate of total optical transceiver market growth in 2025 (transceivers-only basis)
cited_share.value: 58% growth
cited_share.source_name: LightCounting, LightTrends Newsletter, May 2026 — "AI Boom Accelerates Transitions Across the Industry Supply Chain"
cited_share.caveat: A transceivers-only growth rate, a narrower basket than the +74% figure that includes active optical cables — the two are not comparable.

cited_share.metric: Ethernet share of the total optical transceiver market
cited_share.value: 75% of the total market in 2025
cited_share.source_name: LightCounting, LightTrends Newsletter, May 2026 — "AI Boom Accelerates Transitions Across the Industry Supply Chain"
cited_share.caveat: A technology split of the market, not a vendor share. It is what makes the Top 10 effectively an Ethernet ranking.

cited_share.metric: 1Q26 datacom optical component revenue
cited_share.value: record US$7.7bn in the quarter, more than doubling year-over-year
cited_share.source_name: Cignal AI press release — "Datacom Optical Component Revenue Doubles to $7.7 Billion in 1Q26"
cited_share.caveat: The whole market for the quarter, not any one vendor's revenue.

cited_share.metric: 1Q26 vendor leadership in datacom revenue and in high-speed module unit shipments
cited_share.value: Innolight again topped the leaderboard in both datacom revenue and high-speed module shipments, by a wide margin
cited_share.source_name: Cignal AI press release — "Datacom Optical Component Revenue Doubles to $7.7 Billion in 1Q26"
cited_share.caveat: A rank and nothing more: the release attaches no revenue and no percentage to it.

cited_share.metric: 1Q26 telecom optical component revenue
cited_share.value: record US$2.0bn
cited_share.source_name: Cignal AI press release — "Datacom Optical Component Revenue Doubles to $7.7 Billion in 1Q26"
cited_share.caveat: Telecom optical components — the other half of the same quarterly split, shown so the datacom figure is not mistaken for the whole market.

cited_share.metric: Optical transport equipment market growth, 1Q26
cited_share.value: grew 20% year-over-year in 1Q 2026 (Dell'Oro estimate)
cited_share.source_name: Dell'Oro Group press release — "Optical Transport Equipment Market Forecast to Grow 16 Percent in 2026"
cited_share.caveat: A Dell'Oro estimate, and already superseded: the same market grew 15% in the second quarter of 2026.

cited_share.metric: Q1 2026 sales of transceivers and AOCs
cited_share.value: around US$10bn, up more than 90% from Q1 2025 — described as the best quarter since LightCounting began collecting data in 2004
cited_share.source_name: LightCounting, LightTrends Newsletter, June 2026 — Q2 Quarterly Market Update
cited_share.caveat: LightCounting's own estimate for the quarter, on the same basket as the annual figure above.

cited_share.metric: Capex growth assumption underpinning LightCounting's transceiver forecast
cited_share.value: Top-4 CSP capex growth moderating from 70% in 2026 to 30% in 2027
cited_share.source_name: LightCounting, LightTrends Newsletter, July 2026 — July 2026 Cloud Data Center Optics Report
cited_share.caveat: A demand-side assumption behind the transceiver forecast — cloud capital spending, not transceiver sales.

cited_share.metric: Forecast growth in Ethernet optical transceiver sales, and 2031 market size
cited_share.value: +73% in 2026; market to reach US$80bn by 2031
cited_share.source_name: LightCounting, LightTrends Newsletter, July 2026 — "The industry supply chain remains red hot, as investors search for balance between fear and FOMO" (July 2026 Cloud Data Center Optics Report)
cited_share.caveat: Both numbers are forecasts, and the 2026 one supersedes the 65% LightCounting published in April.

cited_share.metric: Optical transport equipment market — full-year forecast
cited_share.value: forecast to grow 16% in 2026, surpassing US$18bn in manufacturer revenue for the first time since the year 2000
cited_share.source_name: Dell'Oro Group press release — "Optical Transport Equipment Market Forecast to Grow 16 Percent in 2026"
cited_share.caveat: Optical transport equipment — the systems layer, a different market and a different vendor set from optical modules.

cited_share.metric: Global shipment share of 800G-and-above optical transceiver modules (technology mix, not vendor share)
cited_share.value: 19.5% in 2024 rising to over 60% by 2026
cited_share.source_name: TrendForce press release — "Google's High-Speed Interconnect Architecture to Push 800G+ Optical Transceiver Share Past 60% by 2026"
cited_share.caveat: A technology mix — the share of shipments running at 800G and above — not a vendor share, and both endpoints are TrendForce estimates.
